name: 04039 · Gray, ME
findings: ZIP 04039 (Gray) has 23 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.

Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 04039 (Gray) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
